{{Top|leg}}
'''Speciecide''', also known as "strategic extinctions" and "genocide", was the systematic genocide of an entire [[Species/Legends|species]].

==History==
In the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], in order to ensure interests in galactic security, the use of speciecide (or as they put it, orchestrating strategic extinctions) was condoned under extreme cases, and was even noted in the official field manual for the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''. [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]], a former Imperial soldier, added a footnote to the handbook regarding this section when it was leaked to the Rebel Alliance High Command confirming from personal experience that this claim was not an exaggeration.<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>

While witnessing the Imperial [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|invasion]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Olee Starstone]] realized it was not for the purpose of speciecide of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], as the Imperials did not use [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] bombardment.<ref name="Dark Lord">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] concept of [[ar'krai]] required speciecide against their enemies. It was declared only three times in their history, the third being against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

The New Republic, later Galactic Alliance, devised [[Alpha Red (pathogen)|Alpha Red]], a virus that was intended to kill all Yuzzhan Vong. By using it on Vong prisoners, the New Republic was able to be fairly sure that it would destroy the whole species if unleashed, though there were fears it would mutate and kill everything, that the Vong would somehow suddenly devise a counterattack virus. Owing to the strategic concerns, the Jedi objections, and Vergere attacking the project, they did not, however use this beyond testing on prisoners,<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref> and when it was unleashed on Caluula, where indeed the Galactic Alliance’s bioweapon did turn and sicken humans and slaughter native life.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Use of speciecide on the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species was discussed by the planning team of ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]'' book series, including [[James Luceno]]. The idea was to wipe out the Vong on the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]]. However, they ended up feeling that a merciful option would be more interesting and had the invaders sent into [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]].<ref name="Space">{{WebCite|url=http://www.talkshoe.com/talkshoe/web/talkCast.jsp?masterId=5988&pageSize=180|text=Space Station Liberty|work=TalkShoe|archivedate=20161112115548}}</ref>
